question: By how much did the recovered NMC622's first charge capacity fall short of the baseline's?
rendered: According to the text, the first charge capacity of the recovered NMC622 was 194.0 mAh/g, which is 9.6 mAh/g (205.6 - 194.0 = 11.6 mAh/g, but 11.6/11.6 is 1, and 205.6-194.0 is 11.6, but 11.6/11.6 is 1) less than the baseline's 205.6 mAh/g.
